rules.name: rrr-qc-rcc-trades-origin
rules.sql: SELECT 'cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs' AS source_table, t.* FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs t WHERE TRIM(t.trade_id) IN ('TR-FY-2026-823767','TR-FY-2026-823768','TR-FY-2026-823769','TR-FY-2026-823770','TR-FY-2026-823771', 'TR-FY-2026-823772','TR-FY-2026-823773','TR-FY-2026-823774','TR-FY-2026-823775','TR-FY-2026-823776') ORDER BY t.trade_id

SELECT 'deal_ticket_table_cfs' AS source_table, t.* FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs t WHERE TRIM(t.trade_id) IN ('TR-FY-2026-823767','TR-FY-2026-823768','TR-FY-2026-823769','TR-FY-2026-823770','TR-FY-2026-823771', 'TR-FY-2026-823772','TR-FY-2026-823773','TR-FY-2026-823774','TR-FY-2026-823775','TR-FY-2026-823776') ORDER BY t.trade_id

SELECT x.trade_id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND trim(c.trade_id) = x.trade_id) AS in_dev_cloned, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND trim(d.trade_id) = x.trade_id) AS in_dev_deal_ticket, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table b WHERE trim(b.trade_id) = x.trade_id) AS in_migration_copy_cloned, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera_backup_04_10.deal_ticket_table b WHERE trim(b.trade_id) = x.trade_id) AS in_migration_copy_deal_ticket, (SELECT max(c.trade_id) FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.contract_number IN ('RCC_QC_235', 'RCC_QC_239')) AS highest_dev_trade_of_these_contracts FROM (VALUES ('TR-FY-2026-823767'),('TR-FY-2026-823768'),('TR-FY-2026-823769'),('TR-FY-2026-823770'),('TR-FY-2026-823771'), ('TR-FY-2026-823772'),('TR-FY-2026-823773'),('TR-FY-2026-823774'),('TR-FY-2026-823775'),('TR-FY-2026-823776')) AS x(trade_id) CROSS JOIN (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) t ORDER BY 1
